fixtures.name: task_received
fixtures.subject: We have your Blueprint job — here is your link
fixtures.body:
Thanks for sending us your job. This private link is where you review your job brief and follow everything that happens next. You can add footage later, once you have recording permission. It opens your site's job without a password, so please don't forward it.

Open your job:
https://tryblueprint.io/capture-upload/local-preview-token

We will email you each time something happens on your job.

— The Blueprint team

fixtures.name: video_received
fixtures.subject: We received your Blueprint walkthrough
fixtures.body:
Your walkthrough arrived safely. Next we check that it covers the work area and that nothing private is in view, then we build the scene. We will email you when that is done.

Open your job:
https://tryblueprint.io/capture-upload/local-preview-token

— The Blueprint team
